## What is KnowMe?
KnowMe (灵犀) explores a personal AI system where voice, memory, knowledge graphs, agents, calendar, tasks, health context and multi-device collaboration become one continuously growing workspace.

## Core idea
Turn AI into your capability.
Agent First. Human Always.

## Current focus
- Huawei Mate60 / Android native client
- Offline Chinese voice capture and transcription
- Personal long-term memory and knowledge growth
- Agent-native workflows
- 2D / 3D knowledge and cognitive graphs
- Calendar, todo and project action loops
- Local-first data boundaries
- Replaceable model and Agent Harness
- Health context and plugin expansion

## Product status boundary
The public website and repository include product demonstrations and engineering evidence. Demo visuals, code existence, engineering candidates, product review, human-owner acceptance and formal release are distinct states and should not be treated as equivalent.
